Dear group,

The APC model specification is similar to the one in Riebler, Held, Rue 2012 (http://projecteuclid.org/download/supzip_1/euclid.aoas/1331043398)
The specification of the multinomial-poisson transformation follows the alligator example. 

My code, model specification and test data (a subset of my data) are here: http://www.wu.ac.at/usr/ma/mzuba/mp-trick%20APC%20model.R

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fail to factorize Q
parts:
On Tue, 2014-07-08 at 12:32 -0700, Martin Zuba wrote:
> Dear group,
>
>
> I am trying to run multivariate APC models using the
> multinomial-poisson transformation.
>

Your run into numerical singular matrices. If you change your initial
value (or constant), to, f.ex


flexible <- list(
prec = list(
initial = log(0.000001),
fixed = TRUE))

then its fine.

H
